verdict.rationale: SolidJS documents its own ability to render components without a browser: isomorphic rendering, full SSR with streaming, and support for Node LTS, Deno and Cloudflare Workers. This implies its components can execute headlessly in automated server environments. However, nothing in the evidence addresses CI pipelines, headless testing, or automation workflows directly. missing for 10: documented CI/automation usage, headless test-runner support, non-interactive tooling or build guidance for pipelines, independent corroboration.
